verified_rules: OS Terrain 50 is an open-data bare-earth DTM product for landscape analysis
grid and contour products are distinct outputs even though they derive from related source data
grid delivery uses 10km by 10km National Grid tiles with 50m post spacing
ASCII grid height values represent the centre of each pixel
the map-header origin is the north-west tile corner while rows read west to east and progress south
each grid tile contains 200 rows of 200 pixels and each pixel is 50m by 50m
height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m
the ASCII header carries ncols nrows lower-left corner and cellsize fields that must be validated before sampling
GML accompanies ASCII data to provide grid spacing vertical reference and spatial-reference metadata
per-tile XML metadata identifies tile reference representation and lineage details and must match the sampled release
